purpose: Account of Alexey's gradual coding-agent setup

required_facts.fact: The author recommends six gradual setup steps.
Several assistants and plan prices are compared.
Real tasks should precede advanced features.
Allow-lists and YOLO permissions are described.
Claude automates LLM Zoomcamp video preparation.
Repeated processes are documented in Markdown.
Skills use assistant-specific folders and frontmatter.
Project context files and session resets are recommended.
